title: RISKS OF AI FOUNDATION MODELS IN EDUCATION

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis of proposed training datasets (e.g., C4, Project Gutenberg) highlighting the exclusion of minoritized language varieties, such as African American English, and the forced accommodation to socially dominant varieties.
Critical evaluation of proposed training data sources (e.g., developer forums like StackOverflow) to show how they can reproduce toxic cultures of masculinity and exclude women.
Literature review and conceptual analysis of automated essay scoring and feedback systems, demonstrating their roots in racialized histories of writing assessments.
Theoretical evaluation of how foundation models homogenize educational content and pedagogical approaches, consequently reproducing dominant cultural ideologies and inequitable paradigms.
Citing existing literature on large web-crawled corpora filtering to demonstrate that data curation disproportionately removes texts discussing LGBTQ+ identities.
